usedFor: Wootric gathers customer feedback, where “Create End User” adds a person and “getAllResponses” retrieves survey responses.

bestTemplate.name: “Create End User” in Wootric
bestTemplate.why: It adds a new end user, so feedback can be tied to a person.

watchOut: “Delete End User” in Wootric deletes by email, so check the address an earlier step passes.
